profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with experience building web applications using Kotlin, Java, Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

I graduated from the software engineering curriculum at App Academy, a highly selective and immersive software engineering bootcamp, where I spent over 100 hours a week honing my coding skills and building projects like Mocdoc. Mocdoc is a Zocdoc clone that helps patients find and book appointments with the right doctors based on their specialty and insurance coverage. This is a project that encapsulates my passion for empowering patients and coding. 

When I'm not coding, I enjoy watching movies or the Office, catching up with basketball, football, the other football, and F1, or just daydreaming about which National/State Parks to visit on my next road trip.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with fellow engineers to develop and test new features for the clinical trial management platform using Typescript, React, Next.js, and Material UI for the frontend, and Python, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI for the backend
• Created reusable React components for the in-house UI library and defined default styles to unify theme across the application
• Developed AWS Lambda services that utilized SNS and SQS for processing and storing UPS tracking data
• Participated in scrum events and reviewed pull requests to streamline feature delivery and reduce development time
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Django · REST APIs · Full-Stack Development · PostgreSQL · Redux Toolkit · FastAPI · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Code Review

positions.title: Regulatory Compliance Analyst
positions.description:
• Resolved over 40 technical support tickets a month and received highly positive customer feedback from all client hospitals
• Provided end-user training for electronic health record system to over 40 hospital super-users
• Identified, documented, and reported bugs/issues related to the ezOntheCall telehealth app - resulting in the successful implementation of telehealth program at six hospitals of Saudi Arabia's Ministry of National Guard – Health Affairs
• Developed Excel VBA scripts to automatically generate monthly maintenance and support invoices for client hospitals, reducing billing errors and saving time spent producing the invoices
• Cleaned over 10,000 rows of hospital drug master data for a successful implementation of drug dispensary system

positions.title: Project Associate
positions.description: • Served on a 4-person team consisting of NYU Wagner graduate candidates to identify strategic recommendations for a community-based organization that assists New Yorkers living with HIV and other chronic illnesses.

positions.title: Math and Sciences Instructor
positions.description:
• Taught SAT and AP math and sciences to over 40 students yearly, resulting in high academic performances and test results.
• Maintained 100% passing rate for all Advanced Placement Calculus exams taken by students.
• Developed math and science curricula and educational materials for the department.

positions.title: Math and Sciences Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored SAT Math, AP Calculus, AP Statistics, AP Chemistry, AP Biology, and AP Computer Science resulting in highly positive feedback from students and parents.
• Maintained 100% passing rate for all Advanced Placement exams taken by students.
• Developed math and science curricula and educational materials for the department

positions.title: Administrative and Billing Assistant
positions.description:
• Registered new patients and confirmed patient financial responsibility.
• Prepared insurance claims, assisted in generating patient statements, and followed up on patient payments.
